verdict.rationale: Official docs say Omarchy includes the Aether application for creating a new theme through a GUI where you can adjust colors and search for backgrounds. Other docs confirm that a theme restyles the whole system (terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper) and that users can make their own themes. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Aether's workflow beyond a single sentence, independent or hands-on corroboration that the GUI theme creator works as described.
